The '''SW-2 [[Ion cannon/Legends|ion cannon]]''' was manufactured by [[ArMek/Legends|ArMek]]. Four SW-2s were mounted on the [[Telgorn Corporation/Legends|Telegorn]] [[Delta-class DX-9 stormtrooper transport|''Delta''-class DX-9 stormtrooper transport]].
